$comment: The template's optional components: what an API may remove (task component:remove -- <name>) and bring back (task component:add -- <name>). Each has a title, the components it needs, the files and directories (ending in /) it owns, and the gates it adds to a stage of task check (spec, implemented) and to task ci. Its sections of shared files are marked component:<name>:start and component:<name>:end; its Renovate rules have a description starting [component:<name>]; its entries in skills.json have "component": "<name>". template is where a removed component is restored from: point it at your own copy if you forked the template.

asyncapi.title: The AsyncAPI contract (specs/asyncapi.yaml), its gates and the CloudEvents envelope: the messages an API receives and the events it publishes

consume.title: Async input: the API takes messages from an SQS queue, each a receive operation of the AsyncAPI contract
